description: Follow-the-sun coverage gaps — Checks whether distributed teams cover the clock. Give teams as name:IANA zone:start-end[:days] comma-separated (e.g. NYC:America/New_York:9-17,London:Europe/London:9-17,Manila:Asia/Manila:9-18; days default mon-fri, also sun-thu, all, overnight hours like 22-06 work). Optional target (24x7 default or 24x5), tz (display zone, default UTC) and date (week to check, DST-aware). Returns coverage percent, gap and overlap hours, every uncovered window with each team's local time, handoff overlaps, hours per team and a FULL COVERAGE / NEAR FULL / GAPS verdict. Offline, instant. Price: $0.003 USDC (Base, via x402).
name: time_coverage
